svg.title: SceneDepthZ: raw device Z (reversed-Z)
svg.desc: Captured buffer visualization. SceneDepthZ: raw device Z (reversed-Z) graph 0001 | DepthPassParallel pass | range 0..0.02534443 | 1=near, 0=far raw device Z 0 (black) .. 0.025344 (white) no geometry (Z == 0) Source payload is the depth subresource of PF_DepthStencil, stored as PF_R32_FLOAT (StoredFormat read from Base/SubresourceLayouts.json). This figure shows the raw reversed-Z device value; it is not linearized and no world-unit claim is made here. The linear view-depth figure uses the exact InvDeviceZToWorldZTransform from the selected View payload. The render target is 1280x888; only the exact 1280x720 view rect (0,0) is published.
